# Cloudmersive Document Conversion: Convert Image Format

Converts an image between formats in Cloudmersive Document Conversion.

```
GET https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-image-format
```

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY` and pass a Cloudmersive Document Conversion `connectionId` ([setup](../authentication.md)).

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET "https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-image-format?connectionId=$CONNECTION_ID&format1=png&format2=jpg&inputFile=iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAIAAAACACAIAAABMXPacAACD3UlEQVR4nAzRgUdcAQDA4XOe5zzPc85znuc8zznPc845z3Oe55znnOecc845SZIkSZIkSZKfJEmSJEmSJEmSJEmSzMzMzMzMzMzMzMzMzMzMbN%2B%2F8EUiEaIRhAhihFgEKYIcQYkQj5CIoEZIRtAi6BFSEYwIZoR0hEwEK4IdIRshFyEfoRDBieBGKEbwIvgRShHKEYIIlQjVCGGEWoR6hEaEZoRWhHaEToSuCN0ReiL0RuiL0B9hIMJghKEIwxFGIoxGGIswHmEiwmSEqQjTEWYizEaYi0CE%2BQgLERYjLEVYjrASYTXCWoT1CBsRNiNsRdiOsBNhN8JehP0IBxEOIxxFOI5wEuE0wlmE8wgXES4jXEW4jnAT4TbCXYT7CA8iPIzwKMLjCE8iPI3wLMLzCC8ivIzwKsLrCG8ivI3wLsL7CB8ifIzwKcLnCF8ifI3wLcL3CD8i%2FIzwK8LvCH8i%2FI0QiUSJRhGiiFFiUaQochQlSjxKIooaJRlFi6JHSUUxophR0lEyUawodpRslFyUfJRCFCeKG6UYxYviRylFKUcJolSiVKOEUWpR6lEaUZpRWlHaUTpRuqJ0R%2BmJ0hulL0p%2FlIEog1GGogxHGYkyGmUsyniUiSiTUaaiTEeZiTIbZS4KUeajLERZjLIUZTnKSpTVKGtR1qNsRNmMshVlO8pOlN0oe1H2oxxEOYxyFOU4ykmU0yhnUc6jXES5jHIV5TrKTZTbKHdR7qM8iPIwyqMoj6M8ifI0yrMoz6O8iPIyyqsor6O8ifI2yrso76N8iPIxyqcon6N8ifI1yrco36P8iPIzyq8ov6P8ifI3%2Bj9AICogCIgCMQFJQBZQBOICCQFVICmgCegCKQFDwBRIC2QELAFbICuQE8gLFAQcAVegKOAJ%2BAIlgbJAIFARqAqEAjWBukBDoCnQEmgLdAS6BLoFegR6BfoE%2BgUGBAYFhgSGBUYERgXGBMYFJgQmBaYEpgVmBGYF5gQQmBdYEFgUWBJYFlgRWBVYE1gX2BDYFNgS2BbYEdgV2BPYFzgQOBQ4EjgWOBE4FTgTOBe4ELgUuBK4FrgRuBW4E7gXeCDwUOCRwGOBJwJPBZ4JPBd4IfBS4JXAa4E3Am8F3gm8F%2Fgg8FHgk8BngS8CXwW%2BCXwX%2BCHwU%2BCXwG%2BBPwJ%%2Bi3wR%2BSryTeS7yA%2BRnyK%2FRH6L%2FBH5K%2F4PiBGNIcQQY8RiSDHkGEqMeIxEDDVGMoYWQ4%2BRimHEMGOkY2RiWDHsGNkYuRj5GIUYTgw3RjGGF8OPUYpRjhHEqMSoxghj1GLUYzRiNGO0YrRjdGJ0xeiO0ROjN0ZfjP4YAzEGYwzFGI4xEmM0xliM8RgTMSZjTMWYjjETYzbGXAxizMdYiLEYYynGcoyVGKsx1mKsx9iIsRljK8Z2jJ0YuzH2YuzHOIhxGOMoxnGMkxinMc5inMe4iHEZ4yrGdYybGLcx7mLcx3gQ42GMRzEex3gS42mMZzGex3gR42WMVzFex3gT422MdzHex%2FgQ42OMTzE%2Bx%2FgS42uMbzG%2Bx%2FgR42eMXzF%2Bx%2FgT42%2Fsf4BEVEKQECViEpKELKFIxCUSEqpEUkKT0CVSEoaEKZGWyEhYErZEViInkZcoSDgSrkRRwpPwJUoSZYlAoiJRlQglahJ1iYZEU6Il0ZboSHRJdEv0SPRK9En0SwxIDEoMSQxLjEiMSoxJjEtMSExKTElMS8xIzErMSSAxL7E \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY"
```

```js
const params = new URLSearchParams({
  connectionId,
  "format1": "png",
  "format2": "jpg",
  "inputFile": ""
});

const response = await fetch(`https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-image-format?${params}`, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MINDCLOUD_API_KEY}`
  }
});

const { success, data } = await response.json();
```

## Inputs

Arguments are sent as query string parameters ([conventions](../arguments.md)).

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format1` | string | yes | Input file format as a file extension, or UNKNOWN for unknown file formats. Default: `png`. |
| `format2` | string | yes | Output file format as a file extension. Default: `jpg`. |
| `inputFile` | file | yes | Input image file to convert. Default: ``. |

## Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "outputFile": "string"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {}
}
```

### Response fields

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outputFile` | string | Converted image file content returned by Cloudmersive. |

## Native endpoint

Through the native Cloudmersive Document Conversion API, this operation is `POST /convert/image/{format1}/to/{format2}` (base URL `https://api.cloudmersive.com`). The Universal API call above is translated to it by MindCloud, including authentication. See the [native action reference](../../native-api/actions/convert-image-format.md) for the provider-specific parameters and requirements.
